name: BRUNO,Inc.
summary: BRUNO, Inc. wholesales and retails interior furnishings, travel-related goods and cosmetics under brands such as BRUNO, IDEA Label, Wild & Wolf, LEXON, MILESTO and MeTIME. It also runs online shops including the Bruno site and travel shop miresto. Formerly IDEA International Co., Ltd., it became BRUNO, Inc. in October 2021 and is a subsidiary of RIZAP GROUP, Inc.
